survey-form-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release: transforms a user's research aim into a fully-structured survey, rendered as a web page that can be filled out and exported.
- Automatically collects and infers essential survey details (topic, audience, purpose) with minimal questioning.
- Utilizes an external API to generate survey structure, with robust fallback to local generation if needed.
- Ensures generated surveys follow best practices—question structure, clarity, and response quality—while handling common edge cases automatically.
- Delivers the survey as a ready-to-use HTML file, using a consistent rendering template.
